questions.stem: A 6-year-old asthmatic boy is brought to the casualty. He is not speaking and has fast shallow breathing. On examination, the chest is silent with paradoxical breathing present. There is an increased respiratory rate and bradycardia. ABG shows respiratory acidosis. What is the best step in the management of this patient?
